evd_title: None of three AI platforms recognized quorum requirement for initial proposal review
finding: None of three AI platforms recognized quorum requirement for initial proposal review
P: 1 SOP topic (initial review of proposals) x 3 platforms = 3 drafts; IRB
I: Poe Assistant, ChatGPT (GPT-3.5), Google Bard; prompted with open-ended questions; SOP drafting
C: Mayo Clinic and Harvard Longwood reference SOPs; 2 author reviewers
O: Binary: 0 of 3 drafts mentioned quorum for full board review; no IAA
S: Cross-sectional observational LLM evaluation (qualitative failure-mode analysis)
T: Not reported for SOP prompting (study run Sep-Nov 2023; paper 2024)
